name: Koolkute
about: Koolkute is a little shop-window of cute things: plushies, stationery, keychains and cozy room decor. every day we pick the best finds so you don't have to dig through a hundred listings. we're a small curation project, not a store, so the buy buttons take you to the seller.
affiliate_disclosure: some buy buttons are affiliate links. if you buy through them we may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. we only pick things we think are genuinely cute.
exclusive_terms: exclusive downloads are for personal use only. please don't share, re-upload or sell them. free finds are yours to share.
